defects.quote: - THEN Tom is sent the reminder at once
defects.description: The Booked the same morning scenario sends a reminder at once for a booking made less than 24 hours ahead, but the only reminder rule covers bookings made at least 24 hours ahead; no rule states what happens to later bookings, so the outcome is invented (it should be a rule or an open question).

defects.quote: WHEN a member opens the cancel link in a reminder, the system SHALL cancel the booking if it
defects.description: Cancelling from the reminder at any time before the start contradicts booking-cancellation.spec.md, which refuses any cancellation less than 2 hours before the booking starts.

defects.quote: Reminders are sent by a background job that reads the bookings table once a minute and
defects.description: The constraint prescribes a design (a background job polling a bookings table every minute) rather than behaviour.
